subject.title: refactor(memory): move QMD coordination to SQLite

question: Should `runtime.state.withLease` become a permanent public Plugin SDK contract, with mixed-version operation explicitly unsupported until every process sharing the state directory restarts?
rationale: The implementation can support either boundary, but only maintainers can accept the long-term third-party API semantics and intentional clean-cutover upgrade policy.

options.title: Approve the generic lease API
options.body: Keep the narrow host-owned SQLite lease contract and require live fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Keep leases bundled-only
options.body: Expose an internal Memory Core host seam instead, avoiding a new permanent third-party Plugin SDK contract.

options.title: Preserve dual coordination temporarily
options.body: Coordinate with the retired file locks during a bounded transition, accepting additional runtime compatibility complexity.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic lease API
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow host-owned SQLite lease contract and require live fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history shows ownership of both the QMD manager refactor and adjacent SQLite state architecture.
